_notes: Adirondack High Peaks (NY) backcountry descents. Geometry from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); run build_backcountry.py after editing.
No avalanche center forecasts the Adirondacks, so every line here is permanently 'no avalanche forecast — conditions score only'.
Listing a line is not a recommendation to ski it.

zone.name: Adirondack High Peaks
zone.no_forecast_note: No avalanche center forecasts the Adirondacks. The slides are avalanche paths (people have died on Wright Peak); NYSDEC posts general backcountry advisories only.

area_hazards.Wright Peak: Wright Peak's open slides above the ski trail are avalanche paths. Above-treeline summit is wind-scoured and icy. Long approach from the Adirondak Loj.
area_hazards.Lower Wolfjaw: Bennies Brook Slide is an open slab slide: avalanche path, often icy, with exposed rock. Long approach and remote.
